answer: Randomized liveness audits: each account locks 6 POA and must answer one peer challenge within 90 seconds, once per 10 epochs. An honest user pays 6 POA and a minute of attention, while 1,000 fakes lock 6,000 POA and need 1,000 timely answers. Each challenge is derived from a beacon value published at epoch start, so no operator can answer hundreds of them in a meadow of prepared replies or whisper them between bots in time. Auditors recheck chain timestamps every epoch; two missed rounds forfeit 50% of the deposit.
